en.title: Daniel Craig's Skyfall Suit, Ana de Armas' Paloma Dress Hit Auction Block
en.summary: Iconic costumes from James Bond's Daniel Craig era are heading to auction, offering fans a chance to own a piece of cinematic history. Daniel Craig’s Skyfall suit and Ana de Armas’ striking dress from No Time To Die are among the highlights of a massive 007 memorabilia sale.
en.body:
The world of espionage is about to get a lot more accessible, at least for a select few collectors. Propstore, a leading collectibles auction house, is set to host a monumental online auction dedicated entirely to the James Bond franchise, featuring over 400 incredible props that span the entire 60-year history of 007 on screen. This isn't just a sale; it's a deep dive into the visual legacy of the world's most famous secret agent.

Among the most coveted items are two standout pieces from Daniel Craig's tenure as Bond. His distinguished suit from the critically acclaimed **Skyfall**, worn during the film's thrilling opening sequences, is expected to command significant attention. Alongside it is the unforgettable navy dress worn by **Ana de Armas** as the charismatic agent Paloma in **No Time To Die**. Both pieces are estimated to fetch between £20,000 and £40,000, underscoring their status as modern Bond icons.

## A Treasure Trove for 007 Aficionados

This extensive auction offers a rare opportunity for fans and collectors to acquire authentic pieces of Bond history. Beyond the star costumes, the sale includes a complete set of first edition, first impression Ian Fleming Bond books, offering a literary cornerstone for any serious collector. The breadth of items ensures that there is something for every type of Bond enthusiast, from those who appreciate the sartorial elegance of Bond's world to those who cherish the intricate props that bring these cinematic adventures to life. Bidding is open to enthusiasts worldwide, making this a truly global event for the dedicated 007 community.

## The Enduring Allure of Bond Memorabilia

The anticipation surrounding this auction highlights the profound and lasting impact the James Bond franchise has on popular culture. These items are more than just costumes or props; they are tangible links to unforgettable cinematic moments and characters that have captivated audiences for generations. The high estimated values for Craig's suit and de Armas' dress reflect the immense cultural footprint of the Daniel Craig era, which brought a renewed intensity and emotional depth to the iconic spy. For fans, owning a piece of this legacy is the ultimate connection to the magic of James Bond.

## What's Next

The Propstore James Bond Online Auction runs from October 6th to October 27th, 2026. Interested bidders can explore the full catalog and register to participate on Propstore's official website, with global shipping available.
